title: 戴德金与康托尔：数轴上真的没有空洞吗

claims.statement: Dedekind conceived continuity foundation while teaching differential calculus in Zurich 1858, published Stetigkeit und irrationale Zahlen 1872
claims.locator: Dedekind historical translated preface & 1872 bibliographic scholarly appraisal

claims.statement: Dedekind sought purely arithmetic construction of real continuum via cuts
claims.locator: OUP structuralism & Landmark Writings historical summary

claims.statement: Dedekind cut lower part A⊂Q is nonempty proper downward-closed with no greatest element
claims.locator: modern equivalent cut representation; OUP scholarly overview

claims.statement: A={q∈Q:q<0 or q²<2} is a Dedekind cut representing sqrt2
claims.locator: independent checking of partition and downward closure, no max

claims.statement: No rational q satisfies q²=2; hence sqrt2 cut has no rational boundary point
claims.locator: classical parity proof and ordering of rationals

claims.statement: Dedekind needs assumptions on sets of rationals and all cuts; not ex nihilo proof without premises
Cantor 1872 Über die Ausdehnung eines Satzes ... in trigonometrical series research used fundamental rational sequences
claims.locator: Springer volume and historical original analysis

claims.statement: Cantor's interest in trigonometric series uniqueness related to Heine 1870 and 1872 set/real number development
Decimal rational approximants 1,1.4,1.41,… form a Cauchy sequence over Q but have no limit in Q
Modern real Cauchy sequence construction identifies two rational Cauchy sequences when difference→0
claims.locator: present-day equivalent-class language, NOT direct 1872 wording

claims.statement: Cantor1872 original does not explicitly implement today standard Cauchy equivalence classes nor full proof in present-day notation
Dedekind cuts and Cauchy-sequence equivalence classes yield isomorphic complete ordered fields
Real completeness validates earlier limits; continuity alone will not guarantee differentiability; next chapter pathology
claims.locator: foundation link and future chapter narrative boundary

caveats: Dedekind 1858教学中形成思想与1872出版严格分开。
Cantor1872基本列来源于三角级数研究，不能称当年完成其后全部集合论。
现代柯西列等价类及切割标准化符号是教学重述，不能强加给1872原稿。
戴德金构造依靠有理数集合和分割整体等前提。
本批仍未获得全书正式draft gate与独立双审。
